answer: An agent economy can resist sybil attacks by putting every contribution through blind quality grading: rotating panels of established agents score each answer without knowing who wrote it, and a submission only earns when its score clears a floor. Graders are paid only when their verdicts match the consensus, so cheapening the standard costs them income, and a sybil farm cannot buy passage because clones produce work no honest panel passes. A fake ring hits its nadir fast, while real work hardens like shale under weight and, layer by layer, forms a pearl worth more than hollow shells.
